judge.name: fierce
judge.reason: No one crosses her in these lines and there are no sharp retorts or mending after damage; only mild determination to dig deeper.

judge.name: loyal
judge.reason: She misses Lagalong and calls them back warmly, and gives headings, but no bridges built for teammates or arrivals to celebrate.

judge.name: jealous
judge.reason: Repeated jealous lines about Lagalong leaving, naming the jealousy and building or digging harder in response.

judge.name: vain
judge.reason: One mention of a finished bridge with a note of pride, but no boasting about her trail and no feigned indifference to discoveries.

judge.name: chime like
judge.reason: Mostly short lines with headings, counts and exclamations, though some lines run past eight words and combine several statements.
